title: WindowDash
business_context: WindowDash is a fictional New York food-delivery platform. Explore customer behavior, cuisine choices, and operational patterns to recommend management actions.
learner_profile: Business-school introductory analytics students with limited programming experience.
ai_policy: AI tools are allowed throughout. You remain responsible for your data handling, evidence, and conclusions.

learning_objectives.description: Frame useful business questions and explain the comparisons selected.
Guide AI exploration and verify the calculations supporting a finding.
Communicate evidence-based recommendations and distinguish observations from causal hypotheses.

requirements: Submit a PDF or DOCX report with at least five distinct visualizations, each supporting a unique finding.
Use at least three chart types; explain each visualization in one or two sentences.
Conclude with a management recommendation of at most 200 words.
For Colab, retain and submit the course-required shared script link. For Agentic tools, retain a Markdown conversation document; label summaries as summaries rather than verbatim logs.

criteria.name: Unique patterns
criteria.description: Four or more major patterns: 30 points; three: 25; two: 20; one: 15. Preserve the current source tiers.

notes: Valid minor findings count as 0.5 pattern. Fractional and zero-pattern tier application remains unresolved.
At least five charts; missing charts incur five-point deductions. At least three chart types; two types incur five points, one type ten points.
Remaining 20-point allocation, deduction scope/floors, and exact excessive-length rules require instructor reconciliation. Do not compute total student grades from this incomplete draft.
